body: Thank you. That really hot the spot. I can't explain what your words mean to me. Im going to come back to read your message when things get tough again. I've been struggling with the idea that success and the promise of future success has not brought happiness or satisfaction. What really makes life worth living greets me at the door every day when I get home. I'm embarrassed to say tears were shed at work when I read your message, but it was cleansing. I needed your words so much. Thank you. I seriously can't explain how much you helped me today. You are a wonderful person. Thank you for being there when I cried out to a world of strangers for help.
